project_context.aesthetic: Brutalist Academic, Archival Swiss, Technical Data Terminal

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Art). Radical weight contrast. No 'Inter' or generic sans for headings.

headings.usage: H1-H4. Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. No center alignment unless specifically tension-driven.

body.usage: All paragraph text, labels, and minor UI elements. Keep leading-relaxed.

mono.usage: Data points, stats, table headers, code blocks.

color_palette.rules: Color is function only. 95% of UI is monochrome. Colors exist only to guide action.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing for marketing, dense/compact for dashboard.

grid_patterns.marketing: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetric. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Mix large spans (col-span-8) with narrow (col-span-4). Empty cells for offset.
grid_patterns.dashboard: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. Dense. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4. 1px borders between cells.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background. 1px solid border (#e4e4e7). Sharp corners (rounded-none).
surfaces.dashboard_widgets: The Grid Borders Look (Technical). border-collapse style. border-r border-b. No drop shadows. Sharp, clinical, accessible.

components_strategy.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn UI, highly customized. Remove rounded corners (rounded-none). Use 1px sharp borders. Active state: ring-0 border-[#002FA7].
components_strategy.buttons: Flat, solid colors. No gradients. Hover state must invert colors or darken significantly. Use data-testid on all buttons.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat header row, monospaced column titles, dense spacing for data.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn Chart components (Recharts). Monochrome styling with a single accent color (#002FA7).
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky nav. Solid background with a hard bottom border. Logo + 3-5 links + CTA. Links must be visible on desktop, no hamburger.
components_strategy.calculator: Pure utility layout. 2-column grid. Left side: input fields (Shadcn forms), Right side: Massive typography output for the result.

home.layout: Asymmetrical hero with overlapping text and image. H1 should break the grid. Use Tetris Grid for secondary sections.

about.layout: Heavy text focus. 2-column split (Left: sticky sticky H2, Right: long scrolling text block). Use generous p-16 padding.

features.layout: Technical grid. 3-column bento box with 1px borders dividing all features. No outer wrapper border. Monospaced numbering for each feature.

data_dashboard.layout: Strict 4-column Control Room grid. Top row: 4 KPI metric widgets (monospaced numbers). Left column: CRUD Submission Form. Right 3 columns: Interactive Data Table (Read). F-pattern hierarchy.

login.layout: Split screen. Left 50% Stark white with sharp auth form (center aligned vertically/horizontally in its column). Right 50% architectural image.

contact.layout: Minimalist layout. Large typography 'Let's Talk'. Functional 1px border form on the right side.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text and bg color change. No floating or scaling. Keep it grounded. e.g., hover:bg-[#002FA7] hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, mechanical. transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out.

media_and_images.rules: Images must have contrast overlays (max bg-black/50) if text is on top. Do not use generic overlays, prefer gradient-to-r if text is left-aligned.

hero_architecture.description: Geometric building interior, use for About or Home feature section

data_center.description: Data center network servers, use for Features or Login screen split

library_elegant.description: Classic library architecture, use as Hero background or Contact page visual

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. All grey text must be at least zinc-500 on white.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tables MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-data-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for structural components and layouts. Strip rounded corners from Shadcn components. Avoid pure center-aligned marketing pages; rely on the asymmetric tetris grid. Use raw 1px borders (border-zinc-200) extensively for structure. Install and use @phosphor-icons/react.
